angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 680,395 km at 130.27 pc = 0.07 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 7.6764 +/- 0.0107 mas (same row, RUWE 0.86): 130.27 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 0.978 +/- 0.021 solar radii from Rea et al. 2026, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-707 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026A&A...711A..86R/abstract): 680,395 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.99 +/- 0.06 solar masses from Rea et al. 2026, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of TOI-707 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026A&A...711A..86R/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 5424 +/- 61 K from Rea et al. 2026, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-707 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026A&A...711A..86R/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Rea et al. 2026, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-707 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026A&A...711A..86R/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/toi-707.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.453, rounded to two decimals
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-707 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] 0.16 dex, from Rea et al. 2026 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026A&A...711A..86R/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-707 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units -0.10846, from Rea et al. 2026 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026A&A...711A..86R/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-707 (pscomppars): age 0.6 Gyr, from Rea et al. 2026 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026A&A...711A..86R/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-707 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 4.9 km/s, from Rea et al. 2026 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026A&A...711A..86R/abstract)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from the star's Gaia DR3 BP/RP spectrum (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
